title: Titanium Immersion Heater Sheath
function: Electric immersion heater protective sheath tube
alloyReason: Grade 2 CP-Ti (UNS R50400) is selected for Titanium Immersion Heater Sheath where formability and corrosion resistance are prioritized over absolute strength. With 40% elongation and excellent weldability, Grade 2 CP-Ti forms a stable TiO₂ passive film that provides immunity to pitting in chloride environments up to 260°C. Its 345 MPa yield strength with 30% elongation makes it ideal for Electric immersion heater protective sheath tube requiring cold forming or bending without cracking. This rationale is driven by electric immersion heater protective sheath tube and fat life requirements.
process: CNC machining CP Ti for tank hardware geometry
TIG welding Ti filler with SPC sampling
Pickling and passivation with SPC sampling
Continuity test <1 mOhm with SPC sampling
surfaceTreatment: Platinum cladding 2.5um minimum via electrodeposition for stable catalytic surface in electrochemical cells — tailored for electric immersion heater application
inspection: Adhesion tape ASTM D3359 (electric immersion verified)
commonFailures: Precious metal drag-out >15% on complex racks - minimized by robotic extract 0.5m/min + air knife — critical for electric immersion heater performance

faq.q: What bath chemistries is Titanium Immersion Heater Sheath resistant to?
faq.a: Grade 2 CP-Ti used in Titanium Immersion Heater Sheath resists attack in hexavalent chromium plating baths (250 g/L CrO₃), sulfuric acid anodizing (15-20% H₂SO₄), nickel sulfamate (300 g/L Ni), and cyanide-based solutions where steel racks corrode at >5 mm/month. Service life in these environments exceeds 12 months continuous immersion for electric immersion heater.

faq.q: What is the typical lead time for Titanium Immersion Heater Sheath orders?
faq.a: Standard lead time for Titanium Immersion Heater Sheath is 15-25 business days depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders (3-5 working days) are available for prototype evaluation. Sample evaluation (1-5 units) can be expedited to 5-7 business days. Volume pricing is available for production quantities above 100 units.

faq.q: What material certifications are provided with Titanium Immersion Heater Sheath?
faq.a: Each Titanium Immersion Heater Sheath shipment includes EN 10204 Type 3.1 mill test certificate with chemical analysis, mechanical properties, and heat identification. Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for electric immersion heater.
